source_title: PM-KISAN Scheme Guidelines & Operational Framework
content:
SCHEME: Pradhan Mantri Kisan Samman Nidhi (PM-KISAN)
CATEGORY: AGRICULTURE
JURISDICTION: central (All India)
MINISTRY: Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare
DESCRIPTION: A Central Sector scheme to provide income support to all landholding farmer families across India to supplement their financial needs for agricultural inputs and domestic requirements.
BENEFITS: Direct Income Support: Financial benefit of Rs 6,000 per year payable in three equal four-monthly installments of Rs 2,000 each. (Rs 6,000 / year); Direct Benefit Transfer: Funds are transferred directly into the Aadhaar-seeded bank accounts of beneficiary farmers without intermediaries. (Direct Bank Transfer)
ELIGIBILITY CRITERIA: Applicant must be an operational farmer / agricultural cultivator. (Source: Operational Guidelines Para 2.1); Applicant or farmer family must hold cultivable agricultural land in their name in state land records. (Source: Operational Guidelines Para 2.2); Applicant or any family member must NOT have paid income tax in the last assessment year (Exclusion Criteria). (Source: Exclusion Criteria Para 3(b))
DOCUMENTS: Aadhaar Card - Mandatory identity verification card seeded with mobile number for e-KYC.; Land Ownership Records - Khasra/Khatauni or Record of Rights (RoR / 7/12 extract) showing clear cultivable land ownership.; Active Bank Account Passbook - Bank account linked with Aadhaar and enabled for NPCI Aadhaar Payment Bridge (APB).
APPLICATION STEPS: Visit the official PM-KISAN portal (pmkisan.gov.in) and navigate to 'Farmers Corner'. -> Click on 'New Farmer Registration' and enter your Aadhaar number and state. -> Fill in personal details, land parcel identification (survey number, dag/khasra number, and area). -> Upload verified land record documents and submit the self-registration form. -> Complete mandatory OTP-based or biometric e-KYC on the portal or via Common Service Centre (CSC).
APPLICATION PORTAL: https://pmkisan.gov.in/RegistrationFormNew.aspx

scheme_name: Ayushman Bharat Pradhan Mantri Jan Arogya Yojana
source_title: National Health Authority - Ayushman Bharat PM-JAY Official Portal
content:
SCHEME: Ayushman Bharat Pradhan Mantri Jan Arogya Yojana (PM-JAY)
CATEGORY: HEALTH
JURISDICTION: central (All India)
MINISTRY: Ministry of Health and Family Welfare / National Health Authority
DESCRIPTION: The world's largest government-funded health assurance scheme providing comprehensive cashless hospitalization cover for vulnerable families in secondary and tertiary care.
BENEFITS: Cashless Hospitalization Cover: Free medical coverage up to Rs 5,00,000 per family per year on a family floater basis across empanelled public and private hospitals nationwide. (Rs 5,00,000 / family / year); Pre and Post Hospitalization Expenses: Covers up to 3 days of pre-hospitalization and 15 days of post-hospitalization diagnostics and medicines. (Included)
ELIGIBILITY CRITERIA: Targeted at families belonging to deprived socio-economic categories as per SECC 2011 or NFSA state ration card thresholds. (Source: NHA Beneficiary Identification Criteria); Family living in kuccha/temporary shelter or deprived conditions without ownership of a high-value urban house. (Source: Rural Deprivation Indicators D1-D7)
DOCUMENTS: Aadhaar Card or Government Photo ID - For individual biometric identification at hospital helpdesk.; Ration Card or Family Identification Document - NFSA Ration Card or Samagra / State Family ID proving household composition.
APPLICATION STEPS: Check your family eligibility online at beneficiary.nha.gov.in using mobile number, Aadhaar, or Ration Card. -> If eligible, visit any empanelled public or private hospital or nearest CSC/Arogya Mitra desk. -> Present your Aadhaar card and Ration card for e-KYC verification. -> Receive your official Ayushman Card (Golden Card) for instant cashless treatment.
APPLICATION PORTAL: https://beneficiary.nha.gov.in/

source_title: Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs - PMAY Guidelines
content:
SCHEME: Pradhan Mantri Awas Yojana - Urban (PMAY-U)
CATEGORY: HOUSING
JURISDICTION: central (All India)
MINISTRY: Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs
DESCRIPTION: A flagship Mission by the Government of India providing all-weather pucca houses to all eligible urban households including slum dwellers, EWS, and LIG categories.
BENEFITS: Interest Subsidy & Construction Grant: Central assistance of Rs 1.5 Lakh under Beneficiary Led Construction (BLC) or interest subsidy under Credit Linked Subsidy Scheme (CLSS). (Rs 1,50,000 to Rs 2,67,000); Basic Civic Infrastructure: Houses built with attached toilet, water supply, electricity connection, and kitchen space. (Infrastructure included)
ELIGIBILITY CRITERIA: The beneficiary family must NOT own a pucca (all-weather concrete) house either in their name or in any family member's name anywhere in India. (Source: PMAY Guidelines Para 1.3); Household annual income must fall within Economically Weaker Section (EWS, up to Rs 3 Lakh) or Low Income Group (LIG, up to Rs 6 Lakh). (Source: PMAY Income Ceiling Classification)
DOCUMENTS: Aadhaar Card of all Family Members - Biometric identity proof for household deduplication.; Income Certificate or Form 16 / Salary Slips - Proof of household annual income below qualifying limits.; Land / House Plot Ownership Document - For Beneficiary Led Construction: Registered sale deed or Patta showing ownership of plot.
APPLICATION STEPS: Visit the official PMAY portal (pmaymis.gov.in) under Citizen Assessment. -> Choose your category: 'For Slum Dwellers' or 'Benefit under other 3 components'. -> Verify with your Aadhaar number and applicant name as per Aadhaar. -> Fill in personal, bank account, household income, and existing housing status details. -> Submit and take printout of the application assessment acknowledgment number for municipal verification.
APPLICATION PORTAL: https://pmaymis.gov.in/

source_title: Micro Units Development & Refinance Agency (MUDRA) Charter
content:
SCHEME: Pradhan Mantri Mudra Yojana (PMMY)
CATEGORY: BUSINESS
JURISDICTION: central (All India)
MINISTRY: Ministry of Finance, Department of Financial Services
DESCRIPTION: Provides collateral-free institutional micro-credit up to Rs 10 Lakh (expanded up to Rs 20 Lakh) to non-corporate, non-farm small and micro enterprises for income-generating activities.
BENEFITS: Collateral-Free Institutional Loan: Loans without requirement of mortgaged property across three tiers: Shishu (up to Rs 50,000), Kishore (Rs 50,000 to Rs 5 Lakh), and Tarun (Rs 5 Lakh to Rs 10 Lakh). (Up to Rs 10,00,000 (Tarun)); Mudra Debit Card: Provides working capital overdraft facility for seamless digital raw material procurement. (Pre-approved limit)
ELIGIBILITY CRITERIA: Applicant must be at least 18 years of age. (Source: Mudra Lending Framework Para 4); Must operate or plan to launch a non-farm micro enterprise, manufacturing unit, trading shop, or service business. (Source: Target Beneficiary Norms)
DOCUMENTS: Proof of Identity & Address - Aadhaar, Voter ID, PAN card, or Driving License.; Business Project Plan / Quotation - Details of machinery to purchase, anticipated cash flow, and cost of enterprise expansion.; Bank Statement (Past 6 Months) - Showing financial transactions and creditworthiness.
APPLICATION STEPS: Prepare a basic business plan stating equipment costs, working capital needs, and revenue projections. -> Choose loan category: Shishu (initial setup), Kishore (growing shop), or Tarun (established enterprise). -> Apply online through the Udyamimitra portal (udyamimitra.in) or visit any commercial bank or MFI branch. -> Submit completed MUDRA application form along with KYC and equipment quotation documents. -> Upon sanction, receive loan disbursement and MUDRA debit card.
APPLICATION PORTAL: https://www.udyamimitra.in/

scheme_name: Post-Matric Scholarship Scheme for SC Students
source_title: Ministry of Social Justice & Empowerment - Post-Matric Scholarship Guidelines
content:
SCHEME: Post-Matric Scholarship Scheme for SC Students (NSP Post-Matric SC)
CATEGORY: EDUCATION
JURISDICTION: central (All India)
MINISTRY: Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment
DESCRIPTION: Centrally Sponsored Scheme to provide financial assistance to Scheduled Caste students studying at post-matriculation or post-secondary stage to enable them to complete their education.
BENEFITS: Full Compulsory Tuition Fee Reimbursement: 100% non-refundable fees (tuition, library, examination, sports fees) credited directly to institution or student account. (Full tuition reimbursement); Monthly Academic Maintenance Allowance: Academic allowance ranging from Rs 2,500 to Rs 13,500 per annum depending on course group (Degree/Professional/Diploma). (Rs 2,500 to Rs 13,500 / year)
ELIGIBILITY CRITERIA: Applicant must be enrolled as a regular student in a recognized post-matric course (Class 11, 12, ITI, Diploma, UG, PG, Ph.D.). (Source: Scheme Guidelines Clause III); Student must belong to a notified Scheduled Caste community. (Source: Scheme Guidelines Clause II(a)); Total combined family annual income from all sources must NOT exceed Rs 2.50 Lakh per annum. (Source: Income Ceiling Clause IV)
DOCUMENTS: Caste Certificate (SC) - Valid digitally signed caste certificate in applicant's name issued by competent revenue authority.; Income Certificate - Current annual income certificate for parents/guardians.; Bonafide Student Certificate & Fee Receipt - Issued by the college/university confirming current enrollment and fee schedule.; Previous Year Marksheet - Passing mark certificate of Matriculation (Class 10) or qualifying examination.
APPLICATION STEPS: Visit the National Scholarship Portal (scholarships.gov.in) and register for an OTR (One Time Registration). -> Login with OTR credentials and select 'Post Matric Scholarship for SC Students'. -> Select your college/institution from the AISHE/DISE registered list. -> Upload caste certificate, income certificate, and previous year academic marksheet. -> Submit application for online verification by your College Nodal Officer (INO) and District Nodal Officer (DNO).
APPLICATION PORTAL: https://scholarships.gov.in/

source_title: Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs - PM SVANidhi Guidelines
content:
SCHEME: PM Street Vendor's AtmaNirbhar Nidhi (PM SVANidhi)
CATEGORY: BUSINESS
JURISDICTION: central (All India)
MINISTRY: Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs
DESCRIPTION: A Central Sector micro-credit scheme launched to empower urban street vendors by providing collateral-free working capital loans and incentivizing digital transactions.
BENEFITS: Graduated Working Capital Credit: First tranche loan of Rs 10,000; on timely repayment eligible for second tranche of Rs 20,000, and third tranche up to Rs 50,000. (Rs 10,000 to Rs 50,000); 7% Interest Subsidy & Digital Cashback: Early or timely repayment receives 7% p.a. interest subsidy credited directly to bank account, plus up to Rs 1,200 annual cashback on digital QR payments. (7% interest subsidy)
ELIGIBILITY CRITERIA: Applicant must be at least 18 years old. (Source: Scheme Framework Section 3); Must be engaged in vending goods, services, food, or apparel in urban or surrounding rural areas. (Source: Beneficiary Definition Clause 2)
DOCUMENTS: Certificate of Vending (CoV) / Vendor ID Card - Issued by the Urban Local Body (ULB) / Town Vending Committee (TVC), or Letter of Recommendation (LoR).; Aadhaar Card - Linked to active mobile number for digital application validation.; Bank Account Details / Passbook - Account in any commercial bank, regional rural bank, or cooperative bank.
APPLICATION STEPS: Verify your vendor status or obtain a Letter of Recommendation (LoR) from your local municipality / TVC. -> Go to the PM SVANidhi portal (pmsvanidhi.mohua.gov.in) and click 'Apply for Loan'. -> Authenticate with your Aadhaar-linked mobile OTP. -> Select the preferred lending institution and submit the loan request. -> Bank verifies and disburses the credit directly into your bank account.
APPLICATION PORTAL: https://pmsvanidhi.mohua.gov.in/

source_title: Department of Posts, Ministry of Communications - Sukanya Samriddhi Rules
content:
SCHEME: Sukanya Samriddhi Yojana (SSY)
CATEGORY: WOMEN_CHILD
JURISDICTION: central (All India)
MINISTRY: Ministry of Finance / Department of Posts
DESCRIPTION: A Government of India backed small-deposit savings scheme targeted at parents of girl children under the 'Beti Bachao Beti Padhao' campaign, offering sovereign guarantees and tax exemptions.
BENEFITS: High Sovereign Interest Rate: One of the highest government savings interest rates (~8.2% per annum, compounded annually). (~8.2% p.a. sovereign interest); Triple Tax Exemption (EEE): Deposits qualify for tax deduction under Section 80C, interest earned is tax-free, and maturity withdrawal is completely exempt from income tax. (Tax-free maturity)
ELIGIBILITY CRITERIA: The child for whom the account is opened must be female. (Source: Government Savings Promotion Act Rule 3); The girl child must not have attained 10 years of age on the date of account opening. (Source: Rules for Account Opening Para 4(1))
DOCUMENTS: Birth Certificate of Girl Child - Official birth certificate issued by municipal body or registrar of births.; Identity & Residence Proof of Guardian - Aadhaar card, PAN card, or Passport of biological or legal guardian.
APPLICATION STEPS: Collect Sukanya Samriddhi Account Opening Form (Form-1) from any Post Office or authorized commercial bank. -> Attach child's birth certificate and guardian's KYC identity and address proof documents. -> Deposit the minimum initial opening amount (minimum Rs 250, maximum Rs 1.5 Lakh per fiscal year). -> Collect the SSY passbook with unique account number for subsequent deposits and tracking.
APPLICATION PORTAL: https://www.indiapost.gov.in/Financial/Pages/Content/Sukanya-Samriddhi-Account.aspx

source_title: Government of Madhya Pradesh - Mukhyamantri Ladli Behna Yojana Portal
content:
SCHEME: Mukhyamantri Ladli Behna Yojana (Madhya Pradesh) (Ladli Behna MP)
CATEGORY: WOMEN_CHILD
JURISDICTION: state (Madhya Pradesh)
MINISTRY: Department of Women and Child Development, Government of Madhya Pradesh
DESCRIPTION: A major state initiative by the Government of Madhya Pradesh to foster economic self-reliance, nutritional security, and decision-making power for women in the state.
BENEFITS: Monthly Direct Financial Assistance: Rs 1,250 deposited directly every month on the 10th into the beneficiary's individual DBT-enabled bank account. (Rs 1,250 / month (Rs 15,000 / year))
ELIGIBILITY CRITERIA: Must be a permanent resident of Madhya Pradesh state. (Source: Scheme Notification Gazette Section 2); Must be female (married, widowed, divorced, or deserted). (Source: Eligibility Norms Section 3(a)); Age must be between 21 and 60 completed years as of January 1 of the calendar year. (Source: Eligibility Norms Section 3(b)); Combined family annual income must be less than Rs 2.50 Lakh. (Source: Exclusion Criteria Rule 4(1)); No member of the applicant's family must be an income tax payer. (Source: Exclusion Criteria Rule 4(2))
DOCUMENTS: Samagra Family ID & Member ID - 9-digit individual Samagra ID with active e-KYC linked to Aadhaar.; Aadhaar Card with Mobile Linkage - Must have updated biometric and active mobile OTP.; Individual DBT-enabled Bank Account - Personal bank account linked to Aadhaar NPCI mapper for Direct Benefit Transfer.
APPLICATION STEPS: Ensure Samagra e-KYC is completed and bank account is NPCI-seeded for DBT. -> Attend designated Gram Panchayat / Ward Level camp or CSC in Madhya Pradesh. -> Officials register application on cmladlibehna.mp.gov.in using biometric / mobile OTP authentication. -> Receive printed acknowledgment receipt and verify provisional list published at Gram Panchayat.
APPLICATION PORTAL: https://cmladlibehna.mp.gov.in/

source_title: Government of Madhya Pradesh - Mukhyamantri Ladli Behna Yojana Portal
content: MUKHYAMANTRI LADLI BEHNA YOJANA GOVERNMENT OF MADHYA PRADESH DEPARTMENT OF WOMEN AND CHILD DEVELOPMENT - OFFICIAL NOTIFICATION 1. SCHEME OBJECTIVES The Mukhyamantri Ladli Behna Yojana was formulated by the Government of Madhya Pradesh to foster health, nutritional well-being, economic self-reliance, and familial empowerment for women residing in the state of Madhya Pradesh. 2.

source_title: Government of Madhya Pradesh - Mukhyamantri Ladli Behna Yojana Portal
content: 2. FINANCIAL BENEFIT Eligible women receive an unconditional Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT) of Rs 1,250 every month (totaling Rs 15,000 annually) directly deposited into their Aadhaar-linked personal bank accounts on the 10th day of each month. 3. ELIGIBILITY NORMS - Domicile: The woman must be a local resident of the state of Madhya Pradesh. - Gender and Marital Status: Woman must be female (married, widowed, divorced, or deserted). - Age Criterion: Must have completed 21 years of age and must not have exceeded 60 years of age as on 1st January of the application year. 4.

source_title: Government of Madhya Pradesh - Mukhyamantri Ladli Behna Yojana Portal
content: 4. INELIGIBILITY / EXCLUSION CRITERIA A woman is ineligible if her family falls into any of the following categories: - Combined annual family income exceeds Rs 2,50,000. - Any family member is an income tax payer. - Any family member is a regular/contractual employee or pensioner of Central/State Government or public undertaking. - Family owns more than 5 acres (approx. 2 hectares) of agricultural land. - Family owns any four-wheeler motor vehicle (excluding tractor used for farming). - Beneficiary is already receiving Rs 1,250 or more per month from any other government DBT scheme. 5.

source_title: Government of Madhya Pradesh - Mukhyamantri Ladli Behna Yojana Portal
content: - Beneficiary is already receiving Rs 1,250 or more per month from any other government DBT scheme. 5. REQUIRED DOCUMENTS - Samagra Family ID and Individual Member ID (with completed e-KYC). - Aadhaar Card with active mobile linkage. - Personal Bank Account linked with Aadhaar NPCI mapper for DBT. - No physical paper certificate or income affidavit is required; verification is conducted via Samagra digital database. 6.

source_title: Government of Madhya Pradesh - Mukhyamantri Ladli Behna Yojana Portal
content: 6. APPLICATION PROCEDURE Applications are accepted during camp sessions organized at every Gram Panchayat in rural areas and Ward offices in urban areas across Madhya Pradesh, or through designated CSC counters.

source_title: Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs - PMAY Guidelines
content: PRADHAN MANTRI AWAS YOJANA - URBAN (PMAY-U) HOUSING FOR ALL MISSION MINISTRY OF HOUSING AND URBAN AFFAIRS - GOVERNMENT OF INDIA 1. OBJECTIVES AND OVERVIEW The Pradhan Mantri Awas Yojana (Urban) was initiated to address urban housing shortage among Economically Weaker Sections (EWS) and Lower Income Groups (LIG), including slum dwellers, by ensuring a pucca house to all eligible urban households. 2. VERTICALS OF THE SCHEME The mission operates through four main verticals: (a) In-situ Slum Rehabilitation (ISSR) using land as a resource with private participation.

source_title: Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs - PMAY Guidelines
content: (b) Credit Linked Subsidy Scheme (CLSS) providing upfront interest subsidy on home loans. (c) Affordable Housing in Partnership (AHP) with public or private sectors. (d) Beneficiary-led individual house construction or enhancement (BLC) providing direct central assistance of Rs 1.50 Lakh. 3. ELIGIBILITY CRITERIA - Household Definition: A beneficiary family comprises husband, wife, unmarried sons, and/or unmarried daughters. - Pucca House Restriction: The beneficiary family must NOT own a pucca (all-weather permanent concrete) house anywhere in India.

source_title: Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs - PMAY Guidelines
content: - Income Ceilings: * Economically Weaker Section (EWS): Household annual income up to Rs 3,00,000. * Low Income Group (LIG): Household annual income between Rs 3,00,001 and Rs 6,00,000. * Middle Income Group I (MIG-I): Annual income between Rs 6,00,001 and Rs 12,00,000. * Middle Income Group II (MIG-II): Annual income between Rs 12,00,001 and Rs 18,00,000. - Mandatory Female Ownership: The house must be registered in the name of the female head of the family or in joint ownership with male head (except in cases of single males/widowers). 4. REQUIRED DOCUMENTS - Aadhaar number of all family members.

source_title: Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs - PMAY Guidelines
content: 4. REQUIRED DOCUMENTS - Aadhaar number of all family members. - Valid Income Certificate or Form 16 issued by employer / Tehsildar. - Land title deed / Patta for Beneficiary Led Construction (BLC). - Bank account details (Account number, IFSC code). - Self-declaration affidavit stating no pucca house is owned anywhere in India. 5. APPLICATION PROCESS Citizens can self-apply at https://pmaymis.gov.in/ under 'Citizen Assessment' or through local municipal corporation offices or Common Service Centres (CSCs).

source_title: Micro Units Development & Refinance Agency (MUDRA) Charter
content: PRADHAN MANTRI MUDRA YOJANA (PMMY) MICRO UNITS DEVELOPMENT & REFINANCE AGENCY (MUDRA) DEPARTMENT OF FINANCIAL SERVICES - MINISTRY OF FINANCE 1. MISSION OBJECTIVE Pradhan Mantri Mudra Yojana (PMMY) aims to 'fund the unfunded' by extending collateral-free institutional credit to non-corporate, non-farm small and micro enterprises. The loans are provided by Commercial Banks, Regional Rural Banks (RRBs), Small Finance Banks (SFBs), MFIs, and NBFCs. 2.

source_title: Micro Units Development & Refinance Agency (MUDRA) Charter
content: The loans are provided by Commercial Banks, Regional Rural Banks (RRBs), Small Finance Banks (SFBs), MFIs, and NBFCs. 2. LOAN PRODUCT CATEGORIES MUDRA loans are structured into three distinct categories based on enterprise development stage: (a) Shishu: Covering loans up to Rs 50,000 for early-stage micro entrepreneurs. (b) Kishore: Covering loans from Rs 50,001 up to Rs 5,00,000 for purchasing machinery, tools, and inventory. (c) Tarun: Covering loans from Rs 5,00,001 up to Rs 10,00,000 for established small enterprises scaling operations (limit enhanced up to Rs 20 Lakh in select sectors). 3.

source_title: Micro Units Development & Refinance Agency (MUDRA) Charter
content: 3. KEY FEATURES - Zero Collateral Requirement: No asset mortgaging is required from the borrower. - Mudra Card: A RuPay debit card providing working capital credit with minimal interest cost on utilized balance. - Processing Fee: Zero processing fee for Shishu and Kishore loans. 4. ELIGIBILITY CRITERIA - Age: Applicant must be an Indian citizen of at least 18 years of age.

source_title: Micro Units Development & Refinance Agency (MUDRA) Charter
content: 4. ELIGIBILITY CRITERIA - Age: Applicant must be an Indian citizen of at least 18 years of age. - Purpose: Must be for an income-generating micro business in manufacturing, trading, or service sectors (e.g., grocery shop, salon, repair workshop, artisanal handicraft, textile garment tailoring, small transport vehicle operation). - Credit History: Must not be a defaulter to any financial institution. 5. REQUIRED DOCUMENTS - Proof of Identity (Aadhaar Card, Voter ID, PAN Card, Driving License). - Proof of Residence (Electricity bill, Ration card, Aadhaar).

source_title: Micro Units Development & Refinance Agency (MUDRA) Charter
content: - Proof of Residence (Electricity bill, Ration card, Aadhaar). - Quotation of machinery, tools, or items to be purchased. - Business registration / Udyam certificate (if available). - Bank statement for the last 6 months. 6. HOW TO APPLY Borrowers can apply online through the portal https://www.udyamimitra.in/ or directly visit any commercial bank or MFI branch with completed application form and project estimate.

scheme_name: Ayushman Bharat Pradhan Mantri Jan Arogya Yojana
source_title: National Health Authority - Ayushman Bharat PM-JAY Official Portal
content: AYUSHMAN BHARAT - PRADHAN MANTRI JAN AROGYA YOJANA (AB-PMJAY) NATIONAL HEALTH AUTHORITY (NHA) - MINISTRY OF HEALTH & FAMILY WELFARE OFFICIAL BENEFICIARY & OPERATIONAL GUIDELINES 1. SCHEME OVERVIEW Ayushman Bharat PM-JAY is the flagship public health assurance scheme of the Government of India. It provides health assurance cover of Rs 5 Lakh per family per year for secondary and tertiary care hospitalization to over 12 crore poor and vulnerable families (approximately 55 crore beneficiaries) representing the bottom 40% of the Indian population. 2.

scheme_name: Ayushman Bharat Pradhan Mantri Jan Arogya Yojana
source_title: National Health Authority - Ayushman Bharat PM-JAY Official Portal
content: 2. source_title: PM-KISAN Scheme Guidelines & Operational Framework
content: PRADHAN MANTRI KISAN SAMMAN NIDHI (PM-KISAN) GOVERNMENT OF INDIA - MINISTRY OF AGRICULTURE & FARMERS WELFARE OFFICIAL OPERATIONAL GUIDELINES 1. OBJECTIVES AND OVERVIEW The Pradhan Mantri Kisan Samman Nidhi (PM-KISAN) scheme was launched on 24th February 2019 by the Government of India. The primary objective is to supplement the financial needs of all landholding farmers' families in procuring various inputs to ensure proper crop health and appropriate yields, commensurate with the anticipated farm income at the end of each crop cycle.

source_title: PM-KISAN Scheme Guidelines & Operational Framework
content: The scheme covers all landholding farmer families in the country, subject to certain exclusion criteria. 2. FINANCIAL BENEFITS Under the scheme, financial benefit of Rs 6,000 per annum per family is provided. This amount is disbursed in three equal 4-monthly installments of Rs 2,000 each. The amount is directly transferred into the bank accounts of the beneficiary farmers via Aadhaar-enabled Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT) through the NPCI platform, completely eliminating leakage and middlemen. 3. ELIGIBILITY NORMS 3.1.

source_title: PM-KISAN Scheme Guidelines & Operational Framework
content: 3. ELIGIBILITY NORMS 3.1. Definition of Farmer Family: A small and marginal landholding farmer family is defined as a family consisting of husband, wife, and minor children who own cultivable land as per land records of the concerned State or Union Territory. 3.2. Landholding Criteria: The applicant must have clear and lawful ownership of cultivable agricultural land registered in the state revenue records (e.g., Khasra, Khatauni, or 7/12 extract). 4.

source_title: PM-KISAN Scheme Guidelines & Operational Framework
content: 4. EXCLUSION CRITERIA (WHO IS NOT ELIGIBLE) The following categories of beneficiaries of higher economic status shall NOT be eligible for benefits under PM-KISAN: (a) All Institutional Landholders. (b) Farmer families in which one or more of its members belong to the following categories: - Former and present holders of constitutional posts. - Former and present Ministers, State Ministers, MPs, MLAs, MLCs, Mayors of Municipal Corporations, and Chairpersons of District Panchayats.

source_title: PM-KISAN Scheme Guidelines & Operational Framework
content: - All serving or retired officers and employees of Central/State Government Ministries, Departments, and Public Sector Undertakings. - All superannuated/retired pensioners whose monthly pension is Rs 10,000 or more. - All persons who paid Income Tax in the last assessment year. - Professionals like Doctors, Engineers, Lawyers, Chartered Accountants, and Architects registered with professional bodies and carrying out profession by undertaking practice. 5. REQUIRED DOCUMENTS - Aadhaar Card (mandatory for identity and e-KYC). - Landholding ownership document (Khasra/Khatauni or Jamabandi/Patta).

source_title: PM-KISAN Scheme Guidelines & Operational Framework
content: - Landholding ownership document (Khasra/Khatauni or Jamabandi/Patta). - Active Bank Account Passbook seeded with Aadhaar and NPCI mapper for DBT. - Valid mobile number linked to Aadhaar for OTP verification. 6. APPLICATION PROCEDURE Eligible farmers can apply online through the 'Farmers Corner' at https://pmkisan.gov.in/ or through Village Level Entrepreneurs (VLEs) at Common Service Centres (CSCs). Mandatory biometric or face-authentication e-KYC must be completed.

source_title: Department of Posts, Ministry of Communications - Sukanya Samriddhi Rules
content: SUKANYA SAMRIDDHI ACCOUNT (SSA) RULES DEPARTMENT OF POSTS / MINISTRY OF FINANCE - GOVERNMENT OF INDIA BETI BACHAO BETI PADHAO MISSION 1. OVERVIEW Sukanya Samriddhi Yojana (SSY) is a government-backed small savings scheme designed specifically for the financial security and higher education empowerment of female children in India. 2. KEY RULES AND ATTRIBUTES - Opening of Account: Can be opened by natural parents or legal guardians in the name of a girl child from her birth until she attains the age of 10 years. - Number of Accounts: Only one account can be opened per girl child.

source_title: Department of Posts, Ministry of Communications - Sukanya Samriddhi Rules
content: - Number of Accounts: Only one account can be opened per girl child. A maximum of two accounts are permitted per family (with exception for twins/triplets as supported by medical certificate). - Minimum and Maximum Deposit: Minimum deposit of Rs 250 per financial year; maximum limit is Rs 1,50,000 per financial year. - Interest Rate: Compounded annually with rates fixed quarterly by the Ministry of Finance (currently ~8.2% p.a.). - Tax Exemption: Eligible for deduction under Section 80C of the Income Tax Act, 1961.

source_title: Department of Posts, Ministry of Communications - Sukanya Samriddhi Rules
content: - Tax Exemption: Eligible for deduction under Section 80C of the Income Tax Act, 1961. The interest earned and the final maturity proceeds are completely tax-exempt (EEE status). - Operation: Account is operated by guardian till girl child attains 18 years of age. - Partial Withdrawal: Up to 50% of the balance at the end of preceding financial year can be withdrawn for higher education expenses after the girl turns 18 or passes Class 10. - Maturity: The account matures after completion of 21 years from the date of opening or at the time of marriage of the girl child after attaining 18 years. 3.

source_title: Department of Posts, Ministry of Communications - Sukanya Samriddhi Rules
content: 3. REQUIRED DOCUMENTS - Birth Certificate of the girl child issued by competent municipal authority. - Identity and Address proof of the parent or legal guardian (Aadhaar, Passport, Voter ID). - Photographs of guardian and child. 4. APPLICATION PROCESS Form-1 can be submitted at any Post Office or designated branches of authorized public and private commercial banks.
